# AI contributor instructions

Follow the repository-wide guidance in `AGENTS.md` and the contribution rules in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

Search before creating helpers, services, scripts, configuration, or documentation. Reuse or extend existing code where practical. Keep changes focused, preserve tenant and exact-server authorization boundaries, add relevant tests, and run the documented verification commands. Never commit credentials, real provider identifiers, player data, production logs, map tiles, private infrastructure, or temporary agent artifacts.
